comparison.objective: Lower a bent tube onto an inspection fixture so all four legs enter their slots together.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual leveling and simultaneous multi-point alignment/insertion without snagging.
comparison.success_condition: All four legs occupy their intended fixture slots with the tube level and safely released; exact rubric thresholds vary by available versions.
comparison.reason: This is coordinated multi-leg fixture placement. The candidate instead tests rotary adjustment and fine tool access followed by quantitative axial impact response; shared alignment alone is insufficient for overlap.
